# Jamie Robertson Joiners

> Joinery-led building contractor based in Stirling, Scotland, trading since 2016. Bespoke kitchens, loft conversions, house extensions and general joinery for homeowners across Stirling and Central Scotland. Fully insured; free, no-obligation quotes.

Jamie Robertson Joiners Ltd is a company registered in Scotland (company number SC530240). The business is joinery-led: most work starts with in-house carpentry and joinery, and other trades are coordinated as needed for larger projects such as extensions and loft conversions.

## Services

- [Bespoke Kitchen Installation](https://jrobertson-joiners.co.uk/services/kitchens/): Precision cabinet fitting, clever storage tweaks, and appliance integration.
- [Loft Conversions & Attic Renovations](https://jrobertson-joiners.co.uk/services/loft-conversions/): Transform unused attic space into bedrooms, offices, or living areas with expert structural joinery.
- [House Extensions & Additions](https://jrobertson-joiners.co.uk/services/extensions/): Single-storey rear extensions, side returns, and larger additions with full project management and multi-trade coordination.
- [Bespoke Joinery & Carpentry](https://jrobertson-joiners.co.uk/services/general-joinery/): Doors, flooring, staircases, bespoke storage, and all aspects of interior carpentry and finishing work.

## Areas covered

- [Stirling](https://jrobertson-joiners.co.uk/areas/stirling/): Home base, including King's Park, Bannockburn, St Ninians, Cambusbarron, Cowie, Plean and Fallin.
- [Bridge of Allan](https://jrobertson-joiners.co.uk/areas/bridge-of-allan/)
- [Dunblane](https://jrobertson-joiners.co.uk/areas/dunblane/)
- [Callander & the Trossachs](https://jrobertson-joiners.co.uk/areas/callander/): Including Doune, Deanston, Thornhill and Aberfoyle.
- [Alloa & Tullibody](https://jrobertson-joiners.co.uk/areas/alloa/)
- [All areas covered](https://jrobertson-joiners.co.uk/areas/)
